api:
<SankeyMatrix data={flows} source={|f: &Flow| f.from} target={|f: &Flow| f.to} value={|f: &Flow| f.amount} />
PropTypeDefault
dataone row per flowrequired
sourceFn(&T) -> &str: the row of the matrixrequired
targetFn(&T) -> &str: the column of the matrixrequired
valueFn(&T) -> f64: rows with the same pair add up; zero, negative and missing values are skippedrequired
show_valuesbool: the value written inside squares that are big enoughtrue
legendLegend: one entry per rowshown

Rows and columns appear in the order they first show up in the data. Each cell is a square whose area is its value. Behind each row, a band as thick as the row's total runs left to right and thins by every cell's value, so what is left of the band is what has not yet been spent. The bars above the columns are column totals. The tooltip shows the value and its share of the row, the column and the grand total. Hiding a row in the legend re-scales everything.

examples.title: Migration
examples.description: Rows are origins, columns destinations. The band leaving each row thins as its flow is spent.
examples.code:
#[component]
fn migration_flows() {
    let data = use_signal(migration());
    rsx! { <SankeyMatrix data={data} source={|f: &Flow| f.from} target={|f: &Flow| f.to} value={|f: &Flow| f.value} class="h-96" /> }
}
